title: Utah Mighty 5 Road Trip Planner Printable, Zion Bryce Arches Itinerary 3 5 7 Days, National Parks Travel Guide PDF, Packing List
description:
Utah's five national parks sit on a single loop of about 500 miles, from the slot canyons of Zion to the arches outside Moab. Seeing them well means planning around shuttles, heat, long drives and parking lots that fill before 9 a.m. This guide covers everything around the hikes.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- When to go: every season, heat, crowds and seasonal road access
- Getting there and around: airports, drive times between the parks, and 2026 park fees and rules
- Where to stay: Springdale, Bryce Canyon City, Torrey, Moab and every park campground
- 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries built around the 10 best day hikes
- Beyond hiking: Scenic Byway 12, the Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway, Island in the Sky, Fruita and dark skies
- Six safety rules for the desert
- A fillable packing list and trip planner, with day-by-day and budget pages

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Information current as of September 2026. Photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits in the guide. Conditions change, so always follow current park guidance on nps.gov. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
